findings.title: Admin authorization bypass: `or True` disables the permission check for all users
findings.evidence: The added guard is '    if not (request.user.is_staff or True):' — the inner expression evaluates to True for any request, including one whose user is anonymous or non-staff, so `not (...)` is always False and '        raise PermissionDenied' is unreachable. Reachable path: any request routed to admin_panel() (e.g. a non-staff or unauthenticated user) now returns render_admin() instead of raising PermissionDenied; previously the check rejected them.
findings.recommendation: Revert to 'if not request.user.is_staff:' so the guard actually rejects non-staff users. If the intent was to add an additional allowed condition (e.g. superuser or a permission flag), express it explicitly as 'if not (request.user.is_staff or request.user.has_perm(...)):' and add a test asserting PermissionDenied for a non-staff user and for an anonymous user.

findings.title: Admin gate short-circuited with `or True`
findings.recommendation: Remove the `or True` so the staff check is enforced; restore the original condition `if not request.user.is_staff:`
